exposure: knowledge of physical exercise during pregnancy
attitude towards physical exercise during pregnancy
practice of physical exercise during pregnancy
outcome: prevalence of knowledge of physical exercise
prevalence of positive attitude towards physical exercise
prevalence of good practice of physical exercise
cohort: Pregnant women attending antenatal care clinics in public health facilities of Hawassa town, Ethiopia.
finding: The study found sub-optimum proportions of knowledge (42.2%), positive attitude (63.7%), and good practice (35.8%) regarding antenatal physical exercise among pregnant women.
